title: No concurrency guard on checkpoint restore; concurrent restore/save-point interleaves worktree rewrites
notes: Partially fixed — remaining part per 2026-09-29 re-check: The UI layer is guarded (630c0af4): useProductRecovery.ts:72,110,137-156 adds a synchronous restoreInFlightRef single-flight guard for restore and manual save, and RecoveryPanel.tsx:101,158,245,264,274,317 disables every restore-adjacent control while isRestoring. The backend is still not guarded: CheckpointEngine::restore_checkpoint (checkpoint/mod.rs:273-302) holds no worktree lock, and ipc/checkpoint.rs has no busy flag. The backend-initiated auto checkpoint (ipc/cards.rs:694 create_checkpoint on card transitions) can still run during a restore, so a restore can still interleave with a snapshot outside the UI path.
repro: Trigger a card transition (cards.rs auto checkpoint) while a RecoveryPanel restore is in flight.
